movie.title: The World's Fastest Indian
movie.overview: The life story of New Zealander Burt Munro, who spent years building a 1920 Indian motorcycle—a bike which helped him set the land-speed world record at Utah's Bonneville Salt Flats in 1967.

facts: Did you know the star of the film isn't just any old bike? It's Burt Munro's incredibly special, highly modified 1920 Indian Scout motorcycle that takes center stage!
Burt Munro's speed records weren't just general achievements; he specifically dominated the category for motorcycles with engines less than 1,000 cc. Talk about precision racing!
Roger Donaldson really poured his heart into this film! He didn't just direct 'The World's Fastest Indian,' he also took on the roles of producer and writer, making it a truly personal vision.
